content: Jev by TypeSafe AI (SF, 40M seed led by DCVC, CEO Diogo Almeida) launched 15 Sep 2026 as early-access API: decision model returning bounded choices/scores/probabilities; vendor claims 70-500 ms, 0.042 USD per M input tokens, free output. No independent benchmarks; early access implies availability/pricing/API-stability risk.
